checklists.name: Rust Engineering Standards
checklists.description: Validation checklist for Rust memory safety, concurrency, error handling, and crate architecture.

items.statement: Ownership, borrowing, and lifetime annotations compile cleanly without bypassing rules via unnecessary clone() or unsafe blocks.
All unsafe blocks are isolated, documented with explicit safety invariant comments, and audited via cargo-geiger.
Errors use Result<T, E> and custom error enums (via main/thiserror or anyhow) with zero unhandled unwrap() or expect() calls in production.
Code satisfies clippy linter checks (cargo clippy -- -D warnings) and formatted via cargo fmt.
Dependencies in Cargo.toml specify exact semver bounds and cargo-audit confirms zero vulnerable crates.
Async tasks use Tokio / async-std context cancellation and avoid blocking the async executor loop.
